text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A Winning Live was being held by the horse 
girl who had won today's race...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone~! Thank you so much for your 
cheers today~! Let's definitely meet here 
again next time too~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAAHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon's live concluded amidst 
thunderous cheers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the live over, she was about to head 
back to the academy, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-san, sorry to keep you waiting! 
Packing up took longer than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Good job out there! Glad you made it in 
time. The next bus back to the academy is 
the last one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Even so, today's Winning Live was super 
exciting!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, Falco feels like the sharpness of the 
final move could've been way more perfect~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I see... Wait, huh? Falco, behind you—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Eh? Behind me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Smart Falcon turned around, a young 
horse girl was standing there, looking at 
her.

text_block_list.name: Young Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Falco-chan! I watched today's live 
from the very front row! It was so 
sparkly, cute, and amazing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Waah! You were watching~?! I'm so happy~!!

text_block_list.name: Young Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
You see, even though I'm a horse girl, I'm 
slow at running... So I felt down and 
thought I was no good.

text_block_list.name: Young Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
But seeing your live filled me with 
energy! I really want to run in races 
too...! And dance just like you, 
Falco-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...!! I see. You're just like me—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Is that so, is that so! Yeah, 
that's a truly wonderful dream!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Since you're here, wanna do a little 
dance lesson with Falco?

text_block_list.name: Young Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Really?! Yes, yes, I wanna do it~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Smart Falcon taught the young 
girl a simple dance choreography.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
See you later~! Let's dance together on 
stage someday, okay?☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The young fan left together with her 
parents.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon was full of satisfaction, but 
as for the last bus...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Uh oh... Ryan-san, I'm so sorry! The bus 
back is gone...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's totally fine! We'll get back 
if we run for about two hours. This is 
great muscle training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Besides—after seeing such a wonderful 
smile from her, I couldn't possibly blame 
you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ryan-san... Ehehe, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Giving all our fans sparkling bright hope! 
That's Falco's way of the Umadol♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Still, being able to move someone's heart 
like that with a Winning Live is 
incredible. It makes me admire you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Eh, admire?! Ryan-san, you admire 
Umadols?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Then—wanna do it? Be an Umadol!! 
Together!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... I mean... Something like that 
isn't really for me...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
With your well-trained figure and 
unadorned, natural smile!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It'll work. —You'll definitely shine☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, let's shine together! Let's 
form a unit!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...W-We really have to get going!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait up~!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ryan-saaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I get it—I totally get it! That zeal, that 
passion!! It's all the exact same as 
muscle training!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Muscle... training?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
What muscle training needs is an 
unyielding spirit and endless passion!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Falco, you have everything it takes! Yeah! 
I sensed your potential long before this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So how about it?! Interested in muscle 
training?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Umm, well, how should I put it~... My 
muscles are kinda sore today, so~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Muscle soreness!! That's the pain of 
muscles growing larger... In other words, 
proof of growth!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Muscle soreness is a chance to grow! Don't 
wait for tomorrow, do it today! No, right 
now!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: G-Give me a break~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, you're training your legs right 
away?! All right, I won't lose to you!!
